summary: Opening of an inner page of a site: breadcrumb trail, title, one lead paragraph, an optional line such as an effective date, and up to two buttons. With a photo it is a short full-width photo band under a brand shade (layout ground, the inner-page form of the photo hero) or a split with the photo in a rounded frame beside the copy (layout side); without a photo it is a plain tinted band. The breadcrumb is filled in from the site's page list. Use only on inner pages of a site.
